threats.threat: recursive training rewrites its own evaluator or pass gates
threats.mitigation: evaluator, seeds, oracle, thresholds, and promotion fields are outside the mutable training surface
every routed assignment uses an exact lower-bound certificate and otherwise completes a full scan

threats.threat: unbounded expert birth consumes memory or compute
threats.mitigation: expert count is capped at 64 and each round may create at most eight children

threats.threat: lineage or topology changes become irreproducible
threats.mitigation: fixed seeds, deterministic tie breaking, and a published lineage digest

threats.threat: synthetic task construction leaks an easy solution into the claim
threats.mitigation: claim is limited to a mechanism proof and formal status remains UNKNOWN

threats.threat: malicious or drifting data causes unstable expert proliferation
threats.mitigation: not established in epoch 1; production and continual-training use are prohibited
